title: The End Has Come

questions.question: What repeatedly emphasized word does the Lord use to announce the judgment on the land of Israel in Ezekiel 7?
questions.explanation: Ezekiel 7:2 (ESV): "And you, O son of man, thus says the Lord God to the land of Israel: An end! The end has come upon the four corners of the land."

questions.question: "Now the end is upon you, and I will send my... upon you, and will judge you according to your ways..."
questions.explanation: Ezekiel 7:3 (ESV): "Now the end is upon you, and I will send my anger upon you, and will judge you according to your ways,"

questions.question: "And my eye will not... you, nor will I have pity, but I will punish you for your ways..."
questions.explanation: Ezekiel 7:4 (ESV): "And my eye will not spare you, nor will I have pity, but I will punish you for your ways,"

questions.question: "Disaster after... ! Behold, it comes."
questions.explanation: Ezekiel 7:5 (ESV): "Disaster after disaster! Behold, it comes."

questions.question: "Your doom has come to you, O inhabitant of the land. The time has come; the day is near, a day of..., not of joyful shouting on the mountains."
questions.explanation: Ezekiel 7:7 (ESV): "the day is near, a day of tumult, and not of joyful shouting on the mountains."

questions.question: "Behold, the day! Behold, it comes! Your doom has come; the rod has blossomed;... has budded."
questions.explanation: Ezekiel 7:10 (ESV): "Behold, the day! Behold, it comes! Your doom has come; the rod has blossomed; pride has budded."

questions.question: "...has grown up into a rod of wickedness. None of them shall remain, nor their abundance, nor their wealth; neither shall there be preeminence among them."
questions.explanation: Ezekiel 7:11 (ESV): "Violence has grown up into a rod of wickedness. None of them shall remain,"

questions.question: Regarding the day of judgment, what is said of the buyer and seller?
options: "Let not the buyer rejoice, nor the seller mourn, for wrath is upon all their multitude."
"The buyer shall weep and the seller shall hide."
"The seller shall flee, but the buyer will find no food."
"Both buyer and seller shall be struck by lightning."
questions.correctAnswer: "Let not the buyer rejoice, nor the seller mourn, for wrath is upon all their multitude."
questions.explanation: Ezekiel 7:12 (ESV): "The time has come; the day has arrived. Let not the buyer rejoice, nor the seller mourn, for wrath is upon all their multitude."

questions.question: "They have blown the... and made everything ready, but none goes to battle, for my wrath is upon all their multitude."
questions.explanation: Ezekiel 7:14 (ESV): "They have blown the trumpet and made everything ready, but none goes to battle, for my wrath is upon all their multitude."

questions.question: Where is the sword, and where are the pestilence and famine?
options: Sword without, pestilence and famine within
Sword to the north, famine to the south
Sword in the daytime, pestilence at night
Pestilence on the mountains, sword in the valleys
questions.correctAnswer: Sword without, pestilence and famine within
questions.explanation: Ezekiel 7:15 (ESV): "The sword is without; pestilence and famine are within. He who is in the field dies by the sword, and him who is in the city famine and pestilence devour."

questions.question: How are the survivors described who escape to the mountains?
options: Like doves of the valleys, all of them moaning, each one over his iniquity
Like scattered sheep without a shepherd
Like frightened gazelles running from a lion
Like eagles returning to a broken nest
questions.correctAnswer: Like doves of the valleys, all of them moaning, each one over his iniquity
questions.explanation: Ezekiel 7:16 (ESV): "And if any survivors escape, they will be on the mountains, like doves of the valleys, all of them moaning, each one over his iniquity."

questions.question: "They cast their... into the streets, and their... is like an unclean thing. Their... and... cannot deliver them in the day of the wrath of the Lord."
questions.explanation: Ezekiel 7:19 (ESV): "They cast their silver into the streets, and their gold is like an unclean thing. Their silver and gold cannot deliver them in the day of the wrath of the Lord."

questions.question: What did the people do with their beautiful ornament, making it an abomination?
options: They used it for pride, and from it they made the images of their abominations
They hid it in the earth so God could not find it
They gave it as tribute to the king of Babylon
They melted it to make swords
questions.correctAnswer: They used it for pride, and from it they made the images of their abominations
questions.explanation: Ezekiel 7:20 (ESV): "His beautiful ornament they used for pride, and they made their abominable images and their detestable things of it. Therefore I make it an unclean thing to them."

questions.question: "I will hand it over to foreigners for... , and to the wicked of the earth for spoil, and they will profane it."
questions.explanation: Ezekiel 7:21 (ESV): "And I will hand it over to foreigners for prey, and to the wicked of the earth for spoil, and they will profane it."

questions.question: "Disaster comes upon disaster; rumor follows rumor. They seek a vision from the... , while the law perishes from the... and counsel from the elders."
questions.explanation: Ezekiel 7:26 (ESV): "They seek a vision from the prophet, while the law perishes from the priest and counsel from the elders."

key_verse_text: "They cast their silver into the streets, and their gold is like an unclean thing. Their silver and gold cannot deliver them in the day of the wrath of the Lord. They cannot satisfy their hunger or fill their stomachs with it. For it was the stumbling block of their iniquity."
